0x000878.en: 「As I am now...@　this is my limit...!」

0x000971.en: 「Damn it!@　Next time you won't get me!」

0x0009EB.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?」

0x000AD2.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000B9B.en: 「Ngh! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000BD6.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@　This isn't fun...」

0x000C2A.en: 「I blew it...!@　No choice but to bail...」

0x000D7B.en: 「So this is the end... the rest is up to you.」

0x000E27.en: 「No good, took too much damage... retreating!」

0x000E74.en: 「I'm beaten. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000EB2.en: 「Kyah, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000EF9.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000FA4.en: 「Ngh... to think I'd become the shooting star... ejecting!」

0x00105B.en: 「Ow ow ow... I give. A miscalculation on my part.」

0x0010E0.en: 「Ngh...! So this is where it ends...!」

0x001194.en: 「I'm sorry. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x0011C9.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my power...!」

0x001286.en: 「Hah... You're as good as they say.」

0x0012B5.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I've still got a lot to learn...!」

0x001303.en: 「No good, this is too much! Pulling back!」

0x001347.en: 「Is... is this the end for me...!?」

0x00137C.en: 「Sorry!@ I'm gonna have to bow out...!」

0x0013ED.en: 「Oh, no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x00142B.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x00145A.en: 「I can't take any more. Please excuse me.」

0x0014E5.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull out for now...!」

0x001709.en: 「Guuh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x001878.en: 「So I've still got a lot to learn...!」

0x00194D.en: 「Guess I've got no choice but to retreat...!」

0x001A19.en: 「Judging by General Kirkus's withdrawal course,@ that must be where they're regrouping their forces.」

0x001A93.en: 「Even though the General has ordered his men@ to surrender to the Feil-Lord's army,@ many still follow him...」

0x001B2C.en: 「Not all of Kirkus's units across the region@ have surrendered to the Feil-Lord's army either.」

0x001BA6.en: 「If we leave General Kirkus be...@ and he uses Louzorl's power to counterattack,@ it'll grow into a full-blown civil war.」

0x001C6A.en: 「Now that we know where the rest of the@ Steel Dragon Squadron are, it pains me@ to ask for your help, but...」

0x001D03.en: 「They say a bird leaves no trace when it flies.@ Having come this far, we can't just look away.」

0x001D7D.en: 「Yes. Let's put an end to this conflict here.@ Yang Long, sortie at once.」

0x001E14.en: 「Whaat!?@ What do you mean, Yang Long!?」

0x001E6A.en: 「A father and son fighting is more than I can bear.@ You don't need to join the next operation.」

0x001ED5.en: 「Y-you can't be serious!@ If I don't stop my father, then who will!」

0x001F31.en: 「Don't get ahead of yourself.@ Could you really pull the trigger on your own father?」

0x001F93.en: 「I... I have no intention of killing my father.@ He needs to live and answer@ for what he's done.」

0x00203C.en: 「That's harder than simply cutting him down, isn't it?@ That's why I'm going too. If I can capture him,@ this battle ends.」

0x0020F3.en: 「...So you'd thought it through that far, Zash.」

0x00212D.en: 「To win a hundred battles isn't the true victory...@ subduing the foe without a fight is. It'll be no easy feat this time, but...」

0x0021F3.en: 「If that's what you're striving for too,@ then I'll rely on your strength.」

0x002258.en: 「Yes.@ And... there's something that troubles me.」

0x0022AF.en: 「Galguard, my father's machine, was scheduled@ for an overhaul at a rear base.」

0x00233B.en: 「That's exactly why I was able to seize it@ right before that happened, but...」

0x0023AC.en: 「It bothers me that he let go of it. Galguard is a@ <Mechanized Armor> with the potential to rival@ the power of a <Mechanized God>.」

0x00246A.en: 「Maybe he meant to keep it in reserve,@ thinking of what lay ahead?」

0x0024C6.en: 「That may be, of course...@ but I feel there's another reason.」

0x002531.en: 「For instance, a more powerful machine@ that surpasses Galguard, prepared and waiting...」

0x002596.en: 「! The Super Mechanized Armor project?@ But that was supposed to be canceled...」

0x0025EF.en: 「Yang Long, Zash! What are you doing!@ Hurry up and get aboard!」

0x002648.en: 「Yes, understood.@ ...Zash, don't throw your life away.」

0x0026B1.en: 「All forward main guns, ready to fire!@ All units, sortie at once!」

0x00271D.en: 「Even if you unify La Gias with the power of an@ evil god, you'll never win the people's hearts.」

0x002794.en: 「If you insist on continuing this savagery,@ people like us will keep rising up to stop you.」

0x00280E.en: 「Heh. It was the same with Masaki and the others...@ As I thought, the Mechanized Gods won't side with me.」

0x00288E.en: 「Is that why you turned to Louzorl for aid?@ The timing of your strike on the Feil-Lord's army too...@ why would you do such a...」

0x002933.en: 「Just before the coronation, Prince Terius fled,@ carried off by Christoph...@ by Shu Shirakawa.」

0x0029F5.en: 「What in the world would Shu@ do that for...!?」

0x002A45.en: 「Who knows.@ I pressed Louzorl about it,@ but he claimed to know nothing.」

0x002AB7.en: 「I see...@ So, having lost your grand figurehead Terius,@ you panicked and struck at the Feil-Lord's army.」

0x002B8D.en: 「He's vanished ever since.@ But thanks to the time he bought me,@ I was able to take delivery of this machine.」

0x002C48.en: 「Super Mechanized Armor Eulid...@ You've heard the name too, haven't you?」

0x002CC6.en: 「Once, General Kirkus proposed it,@ and the plans moved forward...@ a Mechanized Armor to surpass the Mechanized Gods.」

0x002D4D.en: 「So it's a <Mechanized Armor> that's like a <Special Unit>.」

0x002D8E.en: 「To think you kept development going in secret...!」

0x002DCB.en: 「If Eulid had been ready for the battle with Masaki@ and the operation to take the capital,@ I'd never have fallen behind...」

0x002E61.en: 「And once this machine is mass-produced,@ Langran will hold overwhelming power@ without relying on Volkruss.」

0x002F12.en: 「That's what they call counting your chickens@ before they hatch!」

0x002F62.en: 「Hmph... I have other forces as well.@ Behold this.」

0x003026.en: 「Yes. It was damaged when we obtained it,@ but we repaired it here and made it usable.@ With future mass-production in mind.」

0x0030C8.en: 「Bullet, Kusuha...@ do you two know that machine?」

0x003134.en: 「That's a copy of the ultimate robot Valsion...@ the one my father developed.」

0x0031B5.en: 「To think you'd use a thing like that...@ Kirkus, you really are just like my old man.」

0x003229.en: 「Ho, a strange twist of fate.@ But with the power of Eulid and Valsion,@ I have nothing to fear.」

0x0032BC.en: 「Bowing to no evil,@ I can see justice through to the end...」

0x003318.en: 「And unify all of <La Gias>,@ building a world of peace.」

0x00337C.en: 「Even if it drags countless people into it... is that it?」

0x0033CB.en: 「Reform always comes with bloodshed.@ Fear the sacrifices, and nothing gets done.」

0x003427.en: 「Hah, I'm sick of hearing that line!@ You're just saying nothing can be done@ without sacrifices!」

0x0034B7.en: 「...Put that way,@ I can hardly back down myself.」

0x00351C.en: 「So you'll die a martyr to your ambition,@ Kirkus Zan Valfarbia.」

0x003575.en: 「I can't let it end here.@ If other nations learn the truth about@ summoning surface-dwellers, they'll condemn us by every means...」

0x003623.en: 「And even without this incident,@ the calamity the demon gods will bring@ has already been prophesied.」

0x0036AA.en: 「Before it all becomes too late,@ I will unify La Gias and bring order.@ Any who stand in my way, I will remove.」

0x003755.en: 「You mean to become a demon god yourself!」

0x00378C.en: 「For the sake of a great cause, so be it!」

0x0037CF.en: 「Then, as a pilot of a Mechanized God,@ I will stop your ambition!」

0x00382E.en: 「Come, then! I too stand here bearing the fate@ of Langran and La Gias!@ Even old comrades will get no mercy!」

0x0038E5.en: 「Gu, uu...!@ That this Eulid... should be defeated...!」

0x00393B.en: 「I told you! You rely on power too much!」

0x0039B9.en: 「You still have things you have to do!@ Live, and answer for all of it!」

0x003A3C.en: 「Heh... For me to survive here...@ I could never face the soldiers who staked@ their lives and died for me...」

0x003ADB.en: 「Then who is left to atone@ to those you left behind!?」

0x003B37.en: 「Either way... it's too late...@ The ejection system... is broken...@ Not that I ever meant to use it...」

0x003BDA.en: 「Dying here is cowardice!!@ I'll drag you out by force if I have to!!」

0x003C42.en: 「Don't come, Zash...@ Look after your mother... and Remia...」

0x003CE2.en: 「...So he had no intention@ of living on in disgrace...」

0x003D35.en: 「Th-that's... that's cowardice...!@ Taking responsibility by dying...」

0x003DED.en: 「Our paths diverged, but...@ it's true that General Kirkus, too, worried@ for the future of Langran and La Gias...」

0x003E8C.en: 「War is a grave affair of state, the ground of@ life and death, the road to ruin or survival,@ not to be ignored. We must learn that.」

0x003F8D.en: 「Talk like that and no one'll ever marry you,@　little lady!」

0x00403D.en: 「General Kirkus, please, stop this!@　The tide has already turned!」

0x00409F.en: 「No, it isn't over yet!　@　If I quit now, I couldn't face the soldiers@　who laid down their lives for me!」

0x00413B.en: 「That's madness!　Bound to the dead,@　you've lost sight of your own living self!」

0x00419D.en: 「If I don't believe that, then everything@　I've done was for nothing!」

0x004208.en: 「That I will not accept!　I cannot accept it!」

0x00424E.en: 「Kirkus...!@　Very well. I'll settle that debt of yours!」

0x0042B3.en: 「Father!　I will stop you, no matter what!」

0x0042F0.en: 「Fool who cannot grasp my cause!@　I'll show you no mercy, Zashford!」

0x004352.en: 「I'll not have my cause denied and thwarted@　by the likes of you surface-dwellers!」

0x0043AB.en: 「That anger... I understand it, more or less.@　But it was your ambition that dragged us in.」

0x004422.en: 「Kirkus!@　You'll meet the same end@　as Bian Zoldark!」

0x004497.en: 「I'm prepared to die for my cause...@　but now is not that time!」

0x0044F0.en: 「Your actions do nothing but@　spread the flames of war!」

0x004543.en: 「Not now, no...!@　But I have my eyes on La Gias's future!@　This age demands overwhelming power!」

0x0045E2.en: 「Let's see just what a 'super' Elemental@　is really made of!」

0x00463B.en: 「This Eulid won't fall behind@ any machine from the surface!」

0x0046D1.en: 「So you turn against me too, Gennacy!@　Why does no one recognize what I've achieved!?」

0x004739.en: 「Wielding power so recklessly only breeds chaos!」

0x004776.en: 「That's a passing thing!　We haven't the luxury@　of taking our time to settle this!」

0x0047F3.en: 「If you'd all joined my command, La Gias@　could have been united that much sooner...!」

0x004870.en: 「I understand your cause...!@　But there's a problem with how you'd achieve it!」

0x0048F0.en: 「What you'd bring to La Gias isn't peace!@　The moment you reached for a dark god's power,@　you lost all claim to justice!」

0x00498F.en: 「Justice is spoken by the victor!@　Don't think that great sword can cut down my cause!」

0x0049F7.en: 「I can't believe starting a new war here@　does the common people any good...!」

0x004A65.en: 「This battle is for the future of all La Gias!@　History will prove it in the years to come!」

0x004B1C.en: 「General Kirkus, your ambition is dangerous!@　If you lose control of a dark god's power,@　there's no telling what will happen...!」

0x004BCD.en: 「My insurance against Volkruss@ is this very Eulid!」

0x004C32.en: 「General Kirkus!　Shouldn't rebuilding Langran@　be the top priority right now!?」

0x004CB2.en: 「Without securing Langran's sovereignty by force,@　there can be no rebuilding!」

0x004D23.en: 「General Kirkus!@　You're using your power all wrong!@　Don't tell me you don't know it yourself!?」

0x004DB3.en: 「There's no politics that wins everyone's favor!@　Least of all in times of war like these!」

0x004E30.en: Holy Langran Kingdom, Ballantine Province, Sev Temple

0x004E93.en: 「Lune, so you came to <La Gias>@　too, huh...」

0x004EE5.en: 「Finally found you.@　Things were rough on my end too, you know.」

0x004F3E.en: 「So I hear.　I got the gist of it@　before I came here.」

0x004F97.en: 「Same here.　To think it was Prince Feil@　who set the whole surface-summoning off...」

0x005012.en: 「But for some reason the summoning program ran wild...@　and far more surface-dwellers than intended@　got pulled into La Gias.」

0x005100.en: 「Prince Feil was trying to free Langran@　from the Shutedonias invasion, and he@　got ahead of himself.」

0x00519F.en: 「He summoned us to boost his forces, but...@　it turned out just like Tytti said.@　And that only bred more chaos...」

0x005262.en: 「With little time left to live, the Prince@　resolved to unite La Gias by force,@　to end the fighting and settle things...」

0x005301.en: 「...So in the end, Prince Feil reached@　the same conclusion my father did...」

0x005378.en: 「Yeah... We tried to stop him, but@　the Prince chose to take responsibility@　with his own life...」

0x00541A.en: 「The Prince had removed Duraxil's@　escape system beforehand, didn't he...」

0x0054C9.en: 「I'm Mio Sasuga.@　You're Yang Long of Granveil, right?@　Nice to meet you.」

0x005560.en: 「Masaki's on Cybuster, Yang Long's on Granveil,@　Mio's on Zamzeed... so who's piloting@　the last one, Gaddess?」

0x005637.en: 「You're Lune, right?@　I'm Presia Zan Zenosakis.@　My big brother told me all about you.」

0x0056D3.en: 「Oh, right... you're Masaki's stepsister, aren't you.」

0x005744.en: 「...Aww man, your side had way more girls.@　I should've stayed on the Hagane.」

0x0057E6.en: 「That kid over there glued to ART-1,@　she a friend of yours too?」

0x00586A.en: 「...So this is ART-1...@　The way the R-Series and Huckebein lines@　blend together is beautiful.」

0x005916.en: 「I sure can.　The frame's more rigid,@　so shifting the center of gravity@　during crouches looks a lot easier.」

0x0059C2.en: 「She designs <Elementals>, after all.@　And she's studied <Personal Troopers>@　and <specials> too...」

0x005A5E.en: 「So basically she's a huge mecha nut?」

0x005A95.en: 「A bit different from Ryusei's flavor.@ She's even built an Elemental@ based on the Huckebein.」

0x005C0B.en: 「That Elemental... Duraxil is the machine@　Prince Feil piloted at the end.」

0x005C7F.en: 「...!@　S-sorry, I got all excited@　without knowing the story...」

0x005CDF.en: 「No, it's all right. Don't worry about it.@　Sometime, when there's time, I'd love@　to talk mecha at length with you.」

0x005D95.en: 「Mai...!@　Looks like I had you worried plenty.」

0x005E19.en: 「To think you and Kyosuke, who went missing,@　had been here in La Gias...」

0x005E90.en: 「Well, I was pretty shocked myself@　when I came back to this side.」

0x005EE9.en: 「Hey, hey, was Kyosuke lonely@　without me around to see?」

0x005F45.en: 「Nah, he was the same as always.」

0x005F9E.en: （Though I can't really picture@　a lonely Kyosuke.）

0x005FF4.en: 「So that's everyone from the Steel Dragon Squadron@　who got summoned to La Gias accounted for?」

0x00608A.en: 「Everyone but me from ATX and Katina's group,@　Boss and Princess Shine, and Lune@　were all aboard the Hiryu.」

0x006129.en: 「...Lady Raidi, I'm so glad you're safe.」

0x006166.en: 「Same to you, Princess...@　I never dreamed you'd been summoned as well...」

0x0061C5.en: 「...Hey, Kusuha.@　Did you all happen to see a crimson Series 77...@　the Vegalion, anywhere?」

0x006249.en: 「Huh...?　Crimson... you mean@　Sleigh was in La Gias too!?」

0x0062C4.en: 「Maybe...@　But I couldn't confirm@　whether she was actually piloting it...」

0x006383.en: 「We tangled with those annoying brats@　Murata and Argent, though.」

0x0063E8.en: 「Huh?　@　Those three were causing trouble on your side too?」

0x00643B.en: 「Yeah... as mercenaries for the Shutedonias army.」

0x00647B.en: 「Do they mean to stay holed up@　here in La Gias...?」

0x0064D4.en: 「Well, if I run into them,@　I'll teach 'em a lesson.」

0x00652D.en: 「Wait, you... you plan on staying here?」

0x00656D.en: 「Yeah. I've grown fond of La Gias, and...@　more than anything, Masaki's here.」

0x00662A.en: 「Ohoho, that face... could it be, just maybe,@　you're sweet on Lune?」

0x0066D5.en: 「My my, easy to read.@　Well, being straightforward's a good thing§」

0x00673C.en: 「...Colonel Lefina,@　roll call on this side is complete.」

0x006879.en: 「Let me thank you as well.@　And also...」

0x0068C0.en: 「My brother dragged you all into@　Langran's war...@　could you find it in you to forgive him?」

0x00694A.en: 「Of course... we learned a great deal@　ourselves through all this...」

0x0069B5.en: 「It won't be easy from here, but@　please, do your best for La Gias's future.」

0x006AC4.en: 「Right, right. Blow it once for Presia,@　twice for Tytti, three times for me...」

0x006B4B.en: 「Nah, never mind.@　It's a high-performance mini ether communicator.@　It links the surface and La Gias.」

0x006BE7.en: 「If anything comes up, call me.@　If I'm any use, I'll lend a hand.」

0x006C59.en: 「Just so you know, don't call for anything dumb.@　I'll be swamped with cleanup for a while.」

0x006CE2.en: 「Well, that goes both ways. On the surface@　we're listed as missing... once we're back,@　no doubt we'll be buried in reports.」

0x006DA2.en: 「Oh dear...@　Times like these, I'm glad to be a free agent.」

0x006EA7.en: 「Mio, Lune...@　you're really sure about not going back?」

0x006F06.en: 「Well, we can go home anytime we like.」

0x006F49.en: 「I'm Zamzeed's pilot now...@　I've got a duty and a responsibility.」

0x006FC7.en: 「Then you need more training as a pilot, Mio.」

0x007010.en: 「You don't even have a familiar yet.」

0x007041.en: 「For a while, I'll drill you myself.@　I'll put you through the wringer, so brace yourself.」

0x0070D7.en: 「If it's hard training, I'll join too.」

0x007105.en: 「Yes...!　Wait, who!?　When'd you get here!?」

0x00716D.en: 「A f-flawless way of erasing your presence...@　are you a ninja, maybe?」

0x0071E8.en: 「All right, everyone. Let's head back to the capital.@　We've got plenty of work to do.」

0x007272.en: 「Oh, right, once things settle down, let's go on a date, Masaki.」

0x0072D4.en: 「Aargh, you!@　Did you forget you stood me up on a date before!?」

0x007336.en: 「Hmm, that rings a bell... or maybe not...」

0x007379.en: 「Th-then, Lune,@　I'll take you on that date instead...」

0x0073D2.en: 「Sigh...@　We're about to get busy,@　and there's not a shred of tension in you.」

0x007438.en: 「We need to stay sharp.@　Shu and Louzorl and the rest@　are still scheming in the shadows...」

0x0074BF.en: 「And Prince Terius and Princess Monica@　are still missing, after all.」

0x007524.en: 「I know.@　Whatever Shu and Louzorl try to pull,@　we'll stop them with our Masou Kishin...!」
